board_identity: THE DIAMONDEDGE PICK — one pick per game
unified_rule: ONE pick per game: (1) if the champion has a qualifying PLAY on the game (clears its +EV gate) that IS the pick; (2) else if the v4 model grid has a playable lean (clears the +EV gate + 0.01 conviction floor) that is the pick; (3) else if the grid has an EXPANDED-band lean (2026-07-24 on: full +EV gate + conviction 0.0075-0.010 — the measured near-miss band, 104-78-4 / +15.7% ROI walk-forward backtest) that is the pick, flagged expanded_band with REGULAR display stars from the one ladder (mostly 2*), 0.5u stake rail, graded separately under record.expanded_band and folded into by_star_tier with includes_expanded_n; (4) else the game shows its best lean as a PASS (never a bet). One 0-5 score + star ladder (frozen v3.2 percentile score; v3.3 full 1-5 display bands — top ~10% of playable scores -> 5*, next ~25% -> 4*, next ~35% -> 3*, rest -> 2*, non-playable -> 1*; `certified` is a separate boolean, false everywhere today), shared by both sources; one record, graded once per game against finals. `source` is diagnostic only — the UI renders champion- and model-sourced picks identically.
score_reference_version: v3.3 (Leon, 2026-07-25: full 1-5 display scale — stars = frozen percentile bands of the unchanged v3.2 continuous score over playable rows: top ~10% -> 5*, next ~25% -> 4*, next ~35% -> 3*, rest playable -> 2*, non-playable -> 1*; BH certification is the separate `certified` boolean, no longer the 5* gate)

star_cutoffs.version: v3.3 (Leon, 2026-07-25: full 1-5 display scale — stars = frozen percentile bands of the unchanged v3.2 continuous score over playable rows: top ~10% -> 5*, next ~25% -> 4*, next ~35% -> 3*, rest playable -> 2*, non-playable -> 1*; BH certification is the separate `certified` boolean, no longer the 5* gate)
star_cutoffs.basis: v3.3 percentile display bands of the (unchanged) v3.2 continuous score over ALL playable rows of the season replay (v4 totals grid + champion_v2 2026 backfill). Frozen ABSOLUTE score thresholds for live serving — recomputed only when the replay payload regenerates (nightly), never per-day. The -EV floor is hard: non-playable rows stay 1* regardless of score. `certified` (BH significance) is a separate boolean — no display band claims certification.
star_cutoffs.bands: v3.3 percentile display bands of the continuous v3.2 score over playable rows: score >= cutoff_5 -> 5* (top ~10%), >= cutoff_4 -> 4* (next ~25%), >= cutoff_3 -> 3* (next ~35%), else 2*; 1* = non-playable (hard -EV floor). `certified` (BH significance) is a separate boolean — no star band claims certification.

score_basis.recipe: logit(p_cal) = logit(p_mkt) + s * (logit(p_our) - logit(p_mkt)); s fit by penalized IRLS with identity prior s~N(1, 1/25), clamped to [0, 1.25]; NO intercept (the layer refuses to learn the trailing window's over/under rate); expanding-window walk-forward fit on the engine's own graded FG-totals rows (2026 replay pre-block + served graded ledger, y = final vs judged line, pushes/voids dropped, strictly date < D); refit per serve date, frozen first-fit-wins; inactive (identity) below 300 rows / 10 graded days
score_basis.scope: v4 model-grid FULL-GAME TOTALS our_prob only — champion-stream picks, spread/ML/F5 rows, the EV-gate math and every score/star band cutoff are untouched; they simply receive the calibrated probability
score_basis.note: SCORE BASIS CHANGE (activation-dated 2026-07-27, forward only): the model grid's served probability passes through a walk-forward market-anchored calibration map fitted on strictly-past graded picks before the (unchanged) EV gate and score pipeline. Locked picks, graded history and every past score/record are NEVER restated. A calibrated row can never flip sides — only its stated conviction changes. This does NOT create edge and no edge is claimed: it makes the confidence number mean what it says.

signals_note: signals are contextual factors aligned with the lean, not causal attribution — the model is market-anchored and its number is not derived from these factors

expanded_band.rule: model-grid rows with the FULL +EV gate (ev >= 0.015, unchanged) and conviction 0.0075 <= |our_prob - market_devig| < 0.010 are playable 2* fills from the activation date forward — the exact measured near-miss band; every adjacent band (conviction 0.0050-0.0075, any EV-gate relaxation) measured as a loser and stays PASS

backtest.window: 2026-03-25..2026-07-23 (walk-forward rows only; one game per day-game, best-EV wall; graded vs settled finals at the row's own executable price)
backtest.note: BACKTEST (would-have) record — NOT a served record. The served expanded-band record accrues from EXPANDED_BAND_START under record.by_star_tier['2_expanded'], separately from core 2*.

expanded_band.rails: expanded_band=true on the pick; REGULAR display stars from the one v3.3 ladder (mostly 2* — no separate display row; record.by_star_tier carries includes_expanded_n per tier); 0.5u stake regardless of display stars; graded separately (record.expanded_band.served_record); a core playable row always beats an expanded row on the same game; history is never retroactively promoted

engine.model: residual_spread_v1 (rolling engine full-game spread cells — the same live engine that serves totals; direction only)
engine.basis: unproven spread stream — served as an honest LEAN only. The direction is the live model's read of the run line; the pre-pivot spread machinery was adjudicated NOT deployable (no cell cleared matched baselines + Brier + CLV + monotonicity), and the run-line simulator engine verdict (2026-07-27) came back BLOCKED — the margin fitness gate failed and the de-vigged run-line market beat every declared arm. Nothing here is a bet.
engine.upgrade_path: UPGRADE PATH: a future run-line engine that passes its margin fitness gate with a surviving arm and real economics can flip the stream to sim_pricing (P(cover) from a validated joint margin distribution, +EV gate at real per-side prices, max 2*). The 2026-07-27 DERIV_RUNLINE_MARGIN_REPORT verdict was BLOCKED (prereg K1: margin fitness gate failed — no home-field advantage in the engine; and every declared arm, including the no-sim control, lost to the de-vigged market on Brier), so lean_only stands. The flip is explicit and human-signed (state/spread_engine_mode.json) — never automatic, never regex-parsed off a research report.

The stream is new: record starts 0-0-0 at activation, graded in public from day one, no retro-credit, no backtest blended in; unproven-stream star cap until it certifies; -EV at the real price is always a PASS.

definitions.label: The DiamondEdge Pick
definitions.what: The one pick we actually serve on this game: the champion's play if it has one, otherwise the model's best playable lean, otherwise a PASS.
definitions.basis: POPULATION: every (date, game_pk) where the served hybrid produced a graded pick — champion play if present, else the model's best playable lean — exactly one row per game. GRADING: the row's own settled result at the real executable per-side price it was served at, on the line locked at first pitch; pushes return the stake and leave the ROI denominator. HEADLINE COVERS: served picks from 2026-07-20 (the day the hybrid went live) forward only.

definitions.label: Champion engine
definitions.what: The champion engine's own totals play — its frozen pipeline plus the +EV gate at the real per-side price. It only speaks on games where its trigger fires; on every other game it has no view at all.
definitions.basis: POPULATION: every game the champion engine itself rated PLAYABLE and that settled — one row per game (its highest-score playable wall). This is NOT the champion's published headline, which counts one row per game x STREAM at the last decision wall; the two populations are reconciled to a zero residual by champion_headline_residual(). GRADING: champion_v2's own graded ledger, untouched — gate at the median de-vig price, priced and settled at the best executable price at the same line. HEADLINE COVERS: forward paper ledger + live board from 2026-07-02 forward. The 2026-03-27..06-10 rolling-origin rows are a WALK-FORWARD BACKTEST and are reported separately.

definitions.label: V4 model grid
definitions.what: The v4 model grid's best playable totals lean on the game (+EV gate at the real price AND at least 1 point of model-vs-market disagreement).
definitions.basis: POPULATION: every game where the v4 model grid had a playable totals row that settled — one row per game (core playable preferred over an expanded-band row, then highest score). This DELIBERATELY INCLUDES games the champion also played, which record.by_source.model does NOT: by_source counts only the games the model FILLED after the champion passed, so the two numbers differ and neither is wrong. GRADING: the grid's own graded rows — as-of-wall archive where a day has one, else the live graded ledger — at each row's real executable per-side price. HEADLINE COVERS: 2026-07-06 forward (the first day the grid's live ledger graded anything).

definitions.label: Expanded band
definitions.what: The narrow near-miss band: full +EV gate cleared but the model/market disagreement is only 0.75-1.0 points. Live from 2026-07-24, stakes 0.5u, graded on its own.
definitions.basis: POPULATION: v4 model-grid rows that cleared the FULL +EV gate with model-vs-market disagreement of 0.0075-0.010, on games from the 2026-07-24 activation forward — one row per game. A strict SUBSET of model_v4: every expanded pick is also a model_v4 pick. GRADING: same rows, same real prices; staked 0.5u on the weighted line. HEADLINE COVERS: served picks from 2026-07-24 only — the band is never applied retroactively.

definitions.label: Spread stream (run line)
definitions.what: The run-line (±1.5) side per game — a NEW stream, live from 2026-07-27, graded in public from day one, starting 0-0-0. Separate from the totals product in every record.
definitions.basis: POPULATION: every game the run-line stream served from its 2026-07-27 activation forward — one graded row per game (the latest locked wall), stream-stamped rows only. A DIFFERENT MARKET from everything above: it never overlaps, sums with, or competes against any totals record. GRADING: the same board rails as totals — locked at first pitch, graded overnight at the REAL locked per-side run-line price, write-once, pushes returned. HEADLINE COVERS: 2026-07-27 forward only — the stream starts 0-0-0; the pre-pivot spread era (retired 2026-07-07, adjudicated a research NULL) is history, never credit.

status_vocabulary.PICK: this strategy would bet the game at the side/line/price shown
status_vocabulary.PASS: this strategy saw the game and declined — `side`/`line` still carry its lean, `reason` says why it is not a bet
status_vocabulary.NO_VIEW: this strategy produced no row for this game at all — stated explicitly, never silently omitted

Exactly one entry per strategy per game, always all of them, in `order`. games[].pick is UNCHANGED and remains the single served pick; the is_headline entry mirrors it.
strategies_spec.inclusion_bar: A stream is listed only if it is computed every day into a real side/line/price decision AND has its own graded ledger. Closed research fronts (the ~60 tested-and-null mechanisms), spec-only bands, display selections like 'featured', and price-convention variants are NOT strategies and are not here.
strategies_spec.overlap_note: READ THIS BEFORE COMPARING STRATEGIES. (1) THEY OVERLAP: the same game appears in more than one stream — expanded_band is a strict SUBSET of model_v4, and unified is whichever of champion/model_v4 won that game. Their records are NOT additive: do not sum n, units or ROI across strategies, and do not read 'four strategies' as four independent bets. (2) NO POST-HOC PICKING: choosing whichever stream currently looks best is not a strategy — with four overlapping streams on a few dozen graded picks, one of them looks good by construction. The only number that ever described a real bankroll is the served unified pick from its activation date forward. (3) LIVE vs BACKTEST are kept apart on purpose: each strategy's headline n/W-L-P here is its LIVE-SERVED picks only; reconstructed / walk-forward / would-have measurements sit in `backtest`, are labeled, and are never added to the live number. `combined_view` restates the union ONLY because the older published blocks (record.overall, record.by_source) report it — it is not a live record. (4) Sample sizes here are small. None of this is an edge claim.

performance_claim: NONE — the champion stream carries the only live record; the model fills are rated honestly lower. No edge is claimed.
positioning: THE DIAMONDEDGE PICK (Leon, 2026-07-20): one pick per game, one score, one star ladder, one record. The champion's qualifying plays lead; the v4 model fills quiet-champion games so the board is never empty. champion_v2 and the sealed research walk are untouched.
